runtime_no_selection_contract.consumed_state_position: After a selected token decision, consumed_position=len(generated_ids)-1. After a terminal no-selection decision, consumed_position=len(generated_ids), since the whole offered prefix was consumed to produce those logits.
runtime_no_selection_contract.emitted_ID_accounting: Only selected_token_decisions append IDs. A scored EOS is selected and counted, then not fed back. Unknown and unqueried choices remain eligible when the shared query budget reaches zero.
runtime_no_selection_contract.finite_envelope: Start a decision only while selected_IDs<100. Therefore<=100generationforwards/call remains possible, including a terminal no-selection decision. Four calls plus2BOS references retain<=402forward bound, but exact reconciliation must use the new formula.
runtime_no_selection_contract.forward_accounting: generation_forwards = selected_token_decisions + terminal_no_selection_decisions; terminal_no_selection_decisions is0or1. Selector decisions equal generation forwards. BOS references remain separate.
meaningful_tests: All candidates dead after one genuine current-prefix forward: one model lifetime/forward/selector, zero emitted IDs, retained terminal proof/logits and stateposition1.
One or more emitted tokens followed by an all-dead terminal decision: selected trace and terminal trace reconciled separately.
Shared search budget exhausted before all candidates queried: keep unqueried choices UNKNOWN and select by current scores; never call the witness API with illegal cap0.
Successful scored EOS: selected_IDs=forwards, stateposition excludes the unconsumed EOS, no suffix injection.
runtime_no_selection_contract.qualification_state: Design obligation only; no successor runtime or numerical cohort implemented or run by this review.
runtime_no_selection_contract.reason: The current v2 loop assumes every numerical forward selects a token. A score-ranked witness selector can prove all allowed candidates dead only after the current-prefix forward, so that old exact accounting is incompatible.
runtime_no_selection_contract.required_behavior: Retain one terminal no-selection decision with full537 logits, raw argmax, complete dead-choice proofs and reason. Append/feed back no token. Stop blocked; no extra model restoration or retry.
